name: Chambers
author: NachSN
description:
Chambers is a simple deckbuilder heavily inspired by slay the spire.
Chambers is made as a showcase of building some of the systems in slay the spire and may lack the fun-gameplay aspect.

Try to survive for as long as you can by adding new strong cards or removing bad cards from your deck in the shop. Press H for help if you're ever stuck.
